content: Implement the M0110 W0113 static vfio-user control-plane slice: generate DMA map/unmap records from the transport manifest, provide a C17 guest encoder and C++20 host server, validate shared-file mappings by generation and epoch, expose the static BAR0/BAR2/BAR4 profile, and preserve the no-reset/no-migration boundary.

CMake dev configure and focused build passed. Schema validator generated 5 definitions and 15 records. Focused CTest passed 7/7: three transport-schema tests, cdev client/worker, vfio-user guest, and vfio-user server.

The first server fixture exposed a result-width mismatch: the inherited completion result is 32 bytes while the BAR profile is 64 bytes. Added the generated 96-byte vfio-user GET_INFO reply instead of changing the inherited completion ABI; bounded the generic reply copier to its result field.

Content revision cb118f1 adds the compile-checked metaflux_pci.ko static guest resource binder. The driver rejects an unexpected CI VID/DID/class or BAR0/BAR2/BAR4 memory size, maps BAR0 and BAR2, reserves exactly two MSI-X vectors, leaves BAR4 to the PCI MSI-X capability, and unwinds probe/remove resources in reverse order. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

Linux 6.18.42 GCC Kbuild built metaflux_pci.ko with modpost and BTF success; module metadata reports alias pci:v00004D46d00000001sv*sd*bc*sc*i* and vermagic 6.18.42-1-cachyos-lts. Full development CTest passed 79/79, transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records, component graph passed 19 components/23 dependency edges, and git diff --check passed.

This increment is only the static PCI resource binder. It installs no BAR doorbell handler, MSI-X interrupt handler, ring or DMA path, QEMU/libvfio-user integration, Add/Copy execution, drain/tombstone fault qualification, or package qualification; the remaining W0113 gate stays open.
